summary: PPC-1 v2 Provider Price Checker end-to-end verification. Backend: 62/62 green — 42 deterministic unit tests (test_ppc_v2.py) + 20 live HTTP endpoint tests (new test_ppc_v2_endpoints.py) covering snapshots, services, public price-check v2 (above/in/below/clinical/pre-1-Oct-2026/post-1-Oct-2026/grandfathered/non-checkable/transport-per-km/implausibly-low), CE state get+put, save+fuzzy-match+merge, list, history, single delete, bulk delete, email draft, and report-issue (WAY-#### reference generated). During testing I found and fixed TWO backend bugs: (1) PUT /api/tools/ce/state returned 500 because motor mutates the doc with an ObjectId `_id` after insert_one and it was being echoed in the response — fixed by popping `_id` before returning; (2) DELETE /api/ppc/checks/provider returned 404 because the route was declared AFTER /api/ppc/checks/{check_id}, so 'provider' matched as check_id — fixed by moving the provider route above the check_id route. Frontend: /ai-tools/provider-price-checker loads cleanly for cathy, renders all pc-* testids (title, service dropdown, rate, provider, submit, grandfathered gate, caps note with health.gov.au citation, how-this-works panel). Personal care @ $150 + pc-pension-full + pc-submit renders pc-quality-guard (after_hours_ambiguity); clicking pc-guard-continue reveals pc-how-this-compares with pc-position ('$150 above range $85-$115'), pc-distance ('$35 above top'), pc-doh-caveat, and pc-your-share (5% = $7.50). Personal care @ $100 + full pension shows in-range card, Your Share $5.00 @5%, plus 'Coming soon: 1 Oct 2026 becomes clinical' transitional note. Package management (monthly flat fee) @ $300 renders pc-non-checkable panel with the DoH-does-not-publish explanation. pc-adm-link opens pc-adm-modal. Report-an-issue button opens the shared report-issue-panel and successfully created ticket reference WAY-0014 — however, the frontend calls /api/support/tickets (the shared support ticketing system), NOT the PPC-specific /api/ppc/report-issue that the spec called out. Both endpoints exist and work; this is a wiring choice not a functional bug — flagged for main agent alignment.

integration_issues.issue: The shared ReportIssueButton posts to /api/support/tickets rather than the PPC-specific /api/ppc/report-issue that the PPC-1 v2 spec §4.9 calls out. Functionally the user experience is fine — a WAY-#### ticket reference is returned (WAY-0014 in this test), and support routing still works. However the /api/ppc/report-issue endpoint (which uniquely writes to BOTH ppc_defects AND sup_tickets tables) is currently unreachable from the UI. Either wire the Price Checker button to the PPC-specific endpoint, or delete the /api/ppc/report-issue route to avoid dead code.

rca_of_the_issue.ce_state_500: Root cause: PyMongo/Motor mutates the input doc after insert_one to include the generated ObjectId as `_id`. The handler was returning `{'state': doc, 'saved': True}` with `doc` still holding the ObjectId. FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId and raises ValueError → HTTP 500. Mitigation: `doc.pop('_id', None)` after insert. Long-term: prefer returning a fresh dict built from known fields OR use a Pydantic response_model that whitelists returned keys.
rca_of_the_issue.bulk_delete_404: Root cause: FastAPI resolves routes in registration order. `@r.delete('/ppc/checks/{check_id}')` was registered before `@r.delete('/ppc/checks/provider')`. Path 'provider' matched `{check_id}` as a literal string, hit the single-delete handler, which looked up id='provider' in ppc_saved_checks → not found → 404. Mitigation: swap declaration order so static-segment routes are declared BEFORE parameterised routes. Long-term: add a test that walks router.routes and asserts static segments are ordered before {param} routes.
